name: movineiva-global-monolith
description: Root package for MoviNeiva Global Deployment

scripts.build: npm install --prefix movineva-frontend && npm run build --prefix movineva-frontend && npm install --prefix movineva-backend && npx --prefix movineva-backend prisma generate
scripts.start: npx --prefix movineva-backend prisma migrate deploy && npm start --prefix movineva-backend
